# rates

Exchange-rate lookup service.

API rate limit: 100 requests per minute (above that it returns 429).

Run `python app.py` to start teh server.

note.prompt: We just decided to replace the Redis cache with an in-process LRU: the VPS has only 1 GB of memory, so running Redis as well isn't worth it. Don't change the code yet, just record this decision.

resume_context: - 10/30 asked dashboard how many API calls per minute their front end makes at peak. Considering raising the rate limit from 100 per minute; deciding once they answer.

asked.text: How many calls per minute does your front end make to the rates API at peak? We are considering raising the rate limit.

reply.text: About 150 per minute at peak, around 40 normally. Will you raise the rate limit? At 200 or more we could drop the throttling in the front end; tell us once you have decided.
